t: 木卫三、木卫四、木卫一和欧罗巴，尽管直到第二天晚上他才能区分最后两颗卫星。
te: Galileo Galilei makes his first observation of the four Galilean moons: Ganymede, Callisto, Io and Europa, although he …
dz: 伽利略·伽利雷首次观测到伽利略的四颗卫星：木卫三、木卫四、木卫一和欧罗巴，尽管直到第二天晚上他才能区分最后两颗卫星。
de: Galileo Galilei makes his first observation of the four Galilean moons: Ganymede, Callisto, Io and Europa, although he is not able to distinguish the last two until the following night.

t: 法国的亨利四世被天主教狂热者弗朗索瓦·拉瓦利亚克所刺杀,路易十三登上王位.
te: Henry IV of France is assassinated by Catholic zealot François Ravaillac, and Louis XIII ascends the throne.
dz: 法国的亨利四世被天主教狂热者弗朗索瓦·拉瓦利亚克所刺杀,路易十三登上王位.
de: Henry IV of France is assassinated by Catholic zealot François Ravaillac, and Louis XIII ascends the throne.

t: 选美会"伦敦对泰晤士河畔亨利王子的爱"(London's Love to Prince Hen…
te: The pageant London's Love to Prince Henry on the River Thames celebrates the creation of Prince Henry as Prince of Wale…
dz: 选美会"伦敦对泰晤士河畔亨利王子的爱"(London's Love to Prince Henry on the River Thames)庆祝亨利王子被创立为"威尔士王子".
de: The pageant London's Love to Prince Henry on the River Thames celebrates the creation of Prince Henry as Prince of Wales.

t: 迷宫特西斯节在怀特霍尔宫举行,以庆祝威尔士亲王亨利·弗雷德里克的就职典礼.
te: The masque Tethys' Festival is performed at Whitehall Palace to celebrate the investiture of Henry Frederick, Prince of…
dz: 迷宫特西斯节在怀特霍尔宫举行,以庆祝威尔士亲王亨利·弗雷德里克的就职典礼.
de: The masque Tethys' Festival is performed at Whitehall Palace to celebrate the investiture of Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales.

t: 克卢希诺战役是波兰-立陶宛联邦和俄罗斯军队在波兰-俄罗斯战争中交战,之后波兰军队进入莫斯科.
te: The Battle of Klushino is fought between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Russia during the Polish–Russ…
dz: 克卢希诺战役是波兰-立陶宛联邦和俄罗斯军队在波兰-俄罗斯战争中交战,之后波兰军队进入莫斯科.
de: The Battle of Klushino is fought between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Russia during the Polish–Russian War, after which Polish troops entered Moscow.

t: 约翰·盖伊从布里斯托出航,与其他39名殖民者一起前往纽芬兰.
te: John Guy sets sail from Bristol with 39 other colonists for Newfoundland.
dz: 约翰·盖伊从布里斯托出航,与其他39名殖民者一起前往纽芬兰.
de: John Guy sets sail from Bristol with 39 other colonists for Newfoundland.

t: 在亨利·哈德逊寻找"西北行道"期间,他航行到现在被称作"哈德逊湾"的地方.
te: During Henry Hudson's search for the Northwest Passage, he sails into what is now known as Hudson Bay.
dz: 在亨利·哈德逊寻找"西北行道"期间,他航行到现在被称作"哈德逊湾"的地方.
de: During Henry Hudson's search for the Northwest Passage, he sails into what is now known as Hudson Bay.

t: 第一次盎格鲁-波华战争始于殖民的弗吉尼亚.
te: The First Anglo-Powhatan War begins in colonial Virginia.
dz: 第一次盎格鲁-波华战争始于殖民的弗吉尼亚.
de: The First Anglo-Powhatan War begins in colonial Virginia.

t: 克罗迪奥·蒙特韦迪的音乐作品"Vespro della Beatea Vergine"(Ves…
te: Claudio Monteverdi's musical work Vespro della Beata Vergine (Vespers for the Blessed Virgin) is first published, print…
dz: 克罗迪奥·蒙特韦迪的音乐作品"Vespro della Beatea Vergine"(Vespers for the Blessed Virgin)首先出版,由威尼斯印刷并献给教宗保罗五世.
de: Claudio Monteverdi's musical work Vespro della Beata Vergine (Vespers for the Blessed Virgin) is first published, printed in Venice and dedicated to Pope Paul V.

t: 法国国王路易十三在兰斯大教堂加冕。
te: French king Louis XIII is crowned in Reims Cathedral.
dz: 法国国王路易十三在兰斯大教堂加冕。
de: French king Louis XIII is crowned in Reims Cathedral.
